evidence: Changes Guix toolchains and manifests to produce static-pie release binaries under contrib/guix/, labeled Build system.
rationale: Switching official Linux release binaries to static-pie enables execution across non-glibc environments like Alpine Linux and distributions with older libc versions while aiding security hardening. Release notes highlight that binaries 'can now be run on non-glibc based systems, as well as on systems that ship with older glibcs than those previously supported', resolving a recurring platform compatibility barrier.
